definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 'method: A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 describes the same entity in 9.3.4 instead of its definitions clause. GR4 governs the linkage section of every method definition; the set is the same.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:9.3.5 binds a method by name only ("if a method with the method-name specified in the invocation is defined in the class of the object, that method is bound"); 2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching (overloading). GR4 is about access to formals and the returning item once a method is executing, not about which method is bound; the method witnesses pass at --std 2002.
